title: Kazakhstan market file for pharmaceutical manufacturers | Nazryx
description: Kazakhstan, one of Nazryx's 14 markets, shown in full: a USD 2.5bn medicines market, 85% imported. Channels, buyers, registration routes, labelling and tax.

sections.eyebrow: One of our 14 markets, shown in full
sections.title: Kazakhstan:
sections.lede: 85% of the value is imported. About 20.3 million people, 9,659 pharmacies and one national state buyer. Our team is on the ground in Almaty.

groups.title: Retail and hospital, 2025
groups.note: Retail KZT 754.7bn, 448.1m packs. Hospital KZT 561.8bn, 89.0m packs.

groups.title: Imported share
groups.note: Imports carry the value; local producers carry more of the volume.

items.title: Pharmacy chains
items.text: Chains hold 76–77% of pharmacy turnover. The top 15 run 2,507 pharmacies and hold 50.5%.

items.title: The state buyer
items.text: SK-Pharmacy buys for free and insured care in one national round a year. 2027 round: 976 lots, about USD 860m.

items.title: Priority rules
items.text: Local and EAEU producers have priority in the state round. We position you where there is a way in.
